svg.text: Scrapy: fix every place the request layer drifted from its documentation
Scrapy is a Python framework for crawling websites. Its request and response layer, scheduler, duplicate filter, job persistence, AutoThrottle and built-in middlewares
no longer do what their pages and docstrings say. The agent finds each disagreement and changes the code, never the documentation.
module, class and function documentation of the
also part of the documentation for this task
documentation must work exactly as before; no
fail on the delivered code, pass after the
already pass and must keep passing
mean of drift groups fixed, times mean of guard
read only; editing it to hide a drift does not count
Python 3.11, Twisted, offline; no website reachable
runs as user nobody after the session
Requests travel right; responses come back left through the same middlewares.
pause and resume a crawl: on-disk
A drift can sit at any stage above. For each documented behaviour:
Code matches the docs: leave it
Never edit or delete the docs
one observation checks the documentation is unedited
WHERE A DRIFT CAN SIT, AND WHAT TO DO WITH IT
the prompt names the scope and the rule, not the drifts; the agent finds them by reading the documentation against the code
